text: For all federal regulations, 65.1 percent of respondents estimate total compliance time at between 100 and 500 hours, while a noticeable minority of 20.9 percent estimate it above 1000 hours.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Private Fund Industry Five Years after the Dodd-Frank Act – A Survey Study (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2732915

isBasedOn.name: The Private Fund Industry Five Years after the Dodd-Frank Act – A Survey Study

abstract: 65.1% of respondents estimate the total time required to comply with all federal regulations at between 100 and 500 hours. However, a noticeable minority (20.9%) estimate it above 1000 hours.

value: all federal rules and procedures including Treasury, SEC, and CFTC
